title: Per-Framework Quantum Advantage Verdict
description: Canonical verdict record emitted by every framework assessor. Triangulation joins on (paper_id, experiment_id) across frameworks. Layer design: 4 core (benchmark_validity, practicality_crossover, fullstack_resource, finance_domain_realism) + 1 optional veto (nisq_veto).

verdict_semantics.viable: All framework tests pass with high-confidence data
verdict_semantics.likely_viable: Framework's primary test passes; secondary tests indicative but not fully verified
verdict_semantics.potentially_viable: Framework test passes under best-case assumptions; borderline
verdict_semantics.conditional: Verdict depends on a parameter the paper did not report
verdict_semantics.fails: Framework explicitly rules the claim out
verdict_semantics.not_applicable: Experiment is outside this framework's scope (e.g., Chakrabarti on portfolio papers)
verdict_semantics.insufficient_data: Experiment lacks fields the framework requires to decide
